messages:
mira: Quick sync — skew spotted between prebench and runtime latencies for 16k token profiles. bench shows median 120ms/token, runtime telemetry ~200ms/token. Anyone seen this pattern?
jon: saw something similar last week when the kv cache warmup changed. could be cache miss amplification at the edge.
ara: Are these from the same model binary? build id 2026-03-kvopt?
mira: yes same binary. I ran a small repro: `./smoke-run --model=blaze-16k --profile=golden-16k --replays=200` and got the 120ms numbers locally. production traces differ.
sylvia: production traces include routing and prefix normalization overhead — might inflate token time. but 80ms gap is big.
jon: can you paste a short trace snippet?
mira: sure — truncated: ```trace_id=tr-9c3 latency_ms=162 stage=router
stage=runtime latency_ms=128 stage=kvcache miss=true prefix_len=384
stage=decode latency_ms=18```
ara: that `kvcache miss=true` stands out. Are we falling back to cold kv shards due to sampling?
sylvia: yes, we recently changed shard selection to prefer smaller shards for burst capacity. that increases cross-node fetch.
jon: tradeoff then: shard fanout reduces tail but increases per-token avg when miss rate rises. maybe our prebench datasets aren't exercising cross-shard patterns.
mira: exact. prebench uses golden prompts that are short and warm a single shard. runtime traffic has longer prefixes hitting different shards.
ara: proposal: add a small randomized prefix set to the bench to simulate cross-shard misses. keep it opt-in initially.
sylvia: also add a runtime-compatible metric: `kv_cross_shard_rate` to bench output so we can compare apples-to-apples.
jon: agree. And add an interface boundary ticket: bench should be able to annotate replay runs with `routing_policy=v2` vs `routing_policy=v1` so we can reproduce routing behavior.
mira: here's a quick patch I prototyped in the harness: ```yaml
bench:
  replay_count: 500
  inject_prefix_randomness: true
  routing_policy_override: v2
```
ara: perfect. can we make `inject_prefix_randomness` use a small corpus so it's deterministic? seeds should be logged.
mira: yep seed is logged now. also added a smoke command for CI: `ci-bot run smoke --suite=kv_cross_shard`
ci-bot: queued smoke job #8842 — results will post in 12m :hourglass_flowing_sand:
jon: once we have bench parity, we can add a gating rule: if production `kv_cross_shard_rate` - bench `kv_cross_shard_rate` > 10% then fail gating and notify eng-ml oncall.
sylvia: +1. one more thought: maybe runtime should expose a cheap `prefetch_hint` from the routing layer to reduce miss amplification. That's a larger change but could cut the 80ms.
mira: let's do short-term: bench parity + metric parity + canary rollout of smaller routing tweak. long-term: explore prefetch_hint.
ara: I'll open the intake ticket with acceptance criteria: reproducible bench that matches runtime cross-shard rate, CI smoke that fails if gap >10%, and a follow-up RFC for prefetch_hint.
sylvia: assign to me for the metrics work, assigning to jon for gating logic, mira to update bench harness.
mira: I'll push the bench change to branch `bench/kv-parity` and link the PR here. PR: https://git.internal/r/bench/kv-parity :eyes:
jon: thanks — once PR lands let's run a dedicated soak against a small percentage of traffic to validate.
ara: cool. nothing blocking here. thanks y'all :thumbsup:
ci-bot: smoke job #8842 completed — 1 failure (kv_cross_shard_rate diff 12%). tagging @sylvia @jon @mira
